items.title: Chelsea's Mudryk free to play after appeal against doping ban
items.summary: Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk has not played since November 2024 but can return after partially winning his appeal against a four-year doping ban.

items.title: Peer Koopmeiners ziet stap naar Club Brugge wel zitten: 'We hebben gesproken'
items.summary: Peer Koopmeiners is bij afwezigheid van Jordy Clasie de nieuwe aanvoerder van AZ. Voor de bekerwinnaar wacht zondag alweer het begin van het nieuwe seizoen met de strijd om de Johan Cruijff Schaal tegen PSV. Koopmeiners heeft echter ook andere zaken aan zijn hoofd, zoals de transfergeruchten rond Club Brugge. Hij wil daar dan ook geen geheim van maken.

items.title: Bosz voorziet tijdens Johan Cruijff Schaal rol voor teruggekeerde WK-gangers
items.summary: Als Villarreal al langer bezig was geweest met de voorbereiding, had het PSV met dubbele cijfers verslagen. Zo blikte Peter Bosz in aanloop naar het duel met AZ om de Johan Cruijff Schaal terug op de nederlaag tegen de Spanjaarden. De trainer hintte daarnaast op een rol voor enkele onlangs teruggekeerde WK-gangers.

items.title: VI Voorspeltips: de belangrijkste lessen uit het vorige Eredivisie-seizoen
items.summary: Het aftellen naar de start van het Eredivisie-seizoen is in volle gang en dat betekent dat de start van populaire spellen als ESPN Fantasy Voetbal, Topcoach van Scorito en Coach van het Jaar dichtbij komt. Op vrijdag 7 augustus moet de eerste puzzel zijn gelegd. VI PRO schiet jou graag te hulp bij het samenstellen van een selectie.

items.title: Gloukh laat eindelijk zien waarom Ajax hem haalde
items.summary: Oscar Gloukh was de grote man bij Ajax met een hattrick tegen FK Vojvodina. Maar is hij inmiddels de beste voetballer van de Amsterdammers? En waardoor komt zijn sterke vorm ineens wél tot uiting? In deze aflevering van Rondje Europa analyseren Lentin Goodijk en Sander Janssen de ontwikkeling van Gloukh. Ze bespreken zijn nieuwe rol onder de Spanjaard Míchel, waarom hij hoger op het veld speelt, hoe Ajax hem beter in zijn kracht laat komen en waarom dat direct resulteert in doelpunten.

items.title: Bosz gaat op ludieke wijze in op alwéér een vraag over bondscoachschap
items.summary: Arne Slot maakte donderdag bekend dat hij het clubvoetbal verkiest boven het interlandvoetbal. Dat is opnieuw een tegenvaller voor de KNVB, die nog altijd op zoek is naar een vervanger voor de vertrokken Ronald Koeman als bondscoach van Oranje. De naam van Peter Bosz is daarbij al vaak de revue gepasseerd. De trainer van PSV reageert daar in de voorbereiding op de Johan Cruiff Schaal op geheel eigen, ludieke wijze op. Ook de controverse rond FIFA-president Gianni Infantino en zijn omstreden plannen voor het WK komt aan bod.

items.title: Chelsea fined £10m but avoid suspended points deduction
items.summary: Chelsea are fined £10m by the Football Association for breaching rules relating to payments to agents between 2009 and 2022.

items.title: Chelsea fined £10m and given suspended transfer ban by FA over agent breaches
items.summary: Club escape suspended six-point deduction on appeal Owners admitted secret payments by previous regime Chelsea have been fined £10m by the FA and served with a suspended transfer ban for multiple violations of transfer rules during the Roman Abramovich era. The sanction reflects a similar punishment handed to the Blues by the Premier League earlier this year after the club was found to have used unlicensed agents and sought to obscure the nature of their transfer dealings between 2009 and 2022. Deals involving Chelsea legends Samuel Eto’o, Eden Hazard and Willian were amongst those found to have breached the rules. The commission originally handed down a stronger sanction that would have seen Chelsea given a suspended six-point deduction, but it was overturned following an appeal by the club. items.title: Arsenal target Bruno Guimarães not on Newcastle’s flight to pre-season camp
items.summary: Midfielder may still fly to La Manga on Sunday Incoming head coach Jaissle to meet squad in Spain Bruno Guimarães was not on Newcastle’s flight to Murcia on Friday lunchtime as Eddie Howe’s former players prepared to meet their new head coach in southern Spain. As Guimarães, who is believed to be in Brazil, inched closer towards a transfer to Arsenal, Matthias Jaissle was completing his managerial move from Saudi Arabia’s Al-Ahli. Howe’s successor is expected to arrive at the club’s pre-season training camp in La Manga at some point this weekend. Continue reading...

items.title: Fifa rapidly accelerates plan to expand World Cup to 64 teams from 2030 tournament
items.summary: Research analysis to be delivered by 11 September Decision on expansion could be taken this year Fifa is pushing ahead with plans to expand the World Cup to 64 teams from 2030 and has opened a tender to research companies to assess the economic benefits on a hugely accelerated timescale. In another twist during a week of astonishing revelations about the global governing body’s plans to reshape football, the Guardian has seen a “research brief” outlining a consultation process to assess the potential increase from the current 48 teams. A period of just four weeks has been allocated for the successful party, which will be selected on 14 August, to analyse the proposed expansion. Fifa has required that the analysis is delivered by 11 September, indicating a decision could be taken this year. Continue reading...

items.title: Franco Baresi was not only the captain but the moral heart of great Milan team
items.summary: The late centre-back defined an era of Italian defending and his collection of honours is eternal proof of his class There are very few players who become bywords for their position, who enjoy universal acclaim. But for anybody who watched football in the late 80s or early 90s, Franco Baresi was the central defender. He was unsurpassed, obviously the best in his position in the world, the definition of the art of the defending. The oddity is, he really wasn’t like very many other defenders at all. Baresi had just turned 19 when he won his first scudetto at Milan under Nils Liedholm. It was 1979 and Italian football was still dominated by the ideals of catenaccio. Most defences comprised a libero, two man-markers and, if you were lucky, an attacking left-back. But not Liedholm’s. The Swede was a pioneer in Serie A of zonal marking, and the idea that the game was not a series of physical battles but a question of space. Baresi was only 5ft 9in and a teenager. More traditional coaches might not have trusted him. But Liedholm saw an impeccable reader of the game, even at that age. Baresi was an ever-present, not only in the league but in the Coppa Italia and Uefa Cup as well. Continue reading...

items.title: Infantino increasingly embattled after senior adviser resigns over World Cup sell-off plans
items.summary: Infantino’s role as president under increasing pressure 143 of Fifa’s 211 members now stand against scheme Gianni Infantino’s authority has been dealt a fresh blow after Carlos Cordeiro, one of his senior advisers, resigned with immediate effect in protest at proposals to sell a stake in the World Cup. In the latest embarrassment for Infantino, who saw European FAs threaten to boycott future Fifa tournaments on Thursday, the former US Soccer chief Cordeiro criticised “a bad deal for football” and pointed out that the global governing body already sits on huge amounts of debt-free reserves.
